items.stem: Why is the short-run supply curve of a firm the rising part of MC above minimum AVC?

items.stem: Explain why scarcity is the root of all economic problems.
items.answer: Wants are unlimited but resources are limited and have alternative uses; so people must choose what to produce, how and for whom. Without scarcity there would be no need to economise or choose.
items.markingKey: 1 mark: meaning of scarcity; 1 mark: alternative uses; 1 mark: link to choice.
